title: HIGGS: low-density CST middle-layer scaling and quality confirmation
status_note: Atom-count lower-bound research stopped by the owner on 2026-11-06 in favor of FFN/Attention feasibility. Training finished; final scientific admission and assessment remain incomplete. No lower-bound claim is established.

implementation_boundary.library: Public torchcst modules define operator mathematics and parameter ownership.
implementation_boundary.experiment: The pinned torchcst benchmark owns this study's model, optimizer, data splits and selection rules.
implementation_boundary.graph_adapter: Private experiment-cohort Graph adapter at the pinned source; not a supported public torchcst training API.
implementation_boundary.migration: Future runners may move to cst-research through separate validated changes. Do not move or modify the running frozen campaign.

architecture.cst_location: middle layer only; dense input/output layers
architecture.initialization: Stock public CST radius initialization and standard dense initialization; shared ordinary-layer initial values within width/seed; no activation gain calibration
architecture.kernel: radius cell integral M8; spacing=1; physical radius in [0.5,50]
architecture.optimizer: Pinned AdamW proposal and CST Polar update; ordinary/dense WD=0.01, atom raw WD=0, logical amplitude WD=0.01; exact remaining contract is in the pinned runner

data.data_note: Prior validation prefix 8192 belongs to development; no raw data is included in this repository. Archive decompression may touch the full validation array; selection references only its development slice.

edge_extension.rule: Extend only in the direction of a selected base-grid edge; retain an edge flag if final best is still on evaluated boundary.

training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum development cross-entropy, earliest epoch on exact tie
training.learning_rate_selection: Minimum best-development cross-entropy, lower learning rate on exact tie

common_horizon_per_width.trigger: After all 5 development groups finish, ANY selected candidate has best_epoch>=9 AND dev_CE(epoch8)-dev_CE(epoch10)>0.001
common_horizon_per_width.retuning: If triggered, rerun top 2 development LRs per group for 20 epochs; choose by the same development rule; use the same 20-epoch horizon for all configurations at that width.
common_horizon_per_width.still_improving_at20: best_epoch>=19 AND dev_CE(epoch18)-dev_CE(epoch20)>0.001; report an unresolved tail, do not silently extend after confirmation.

training.confirmation_freeze: Freeze all 30 checkpoint hashes, hyperparameters, horizons and data identities before evaluating confirmation 50k; per-seed checkpoint selection uses development only.

statistics.difference: CST minus dense for paired training seed
statistics.accuracy_margin_unit: probability; 0.2 percentage points, not a relative percentage

primary.method: intersection-union of two co-primary one-sided paired-seed noninferiority t tests
primary.zero_standard_error: p=0 if mean_difference+margin>0; otherwise p=1 including the exact boundary

diagnostics.simultaneous_seed_t: Two-sided95% Bonferroni over 16 endpoints, df2, critical approximately 17.8466; inferiority supported if either upper bound is below -margin

paired_case_bootstrap.method: Shared resampled example weights across both methods and all 3 seeds; exact weighted tie-aware empirical AUC; mean single-seed metrics
paired_case_bootstrap.scope: Conditional on the six fixed learned models; no joint seed/example confidence guarantee

diagnostics.empirical_candidate: All3 seed point estimates within both margins; not formal support

statistics.assumptions: Approximately normal IID paired seed differences, conditional on the fixed confirmation benchmark; three seeds have limited power and cannot validate normality.
statistics.minimum_alpha_scope: Smallest supported tested point only; smaller inconclusive points leave boundary unresolved. If 0.001 passes, required density may be below 0.001. No monotonicity or universal/continuous optimum is assumed.
statistics.adaptive_alpha_additions: Exploratory and excluded from this formal family

protocol.correctness: Independent public CPU FP64 and quadrature Y/dX/all-parameter-gradient references; eager/Graph whole-step parameter/optimizer/gradient/clock byte comparisons; qualification may use dev32, production requires dev50000

measurement.training_time: Synchronized complete gather/forward/loss/backward/update/metric time; excludes evaluation/checkpoint/hash diagnostics
measurement.memory: CUDA allocator allocated/reserved peaks including capture; not total GPU process memory
measurement.hpo_timing_caveat: HPO groups can span separate L4 VMs; CPU host model was not recorded. Cross-job HPO timing overlays are exploratory.
measurement.primary_timing_comparison: Within-job dense versus all 4 CST configurations at each width/confirmation seed; preserve job provenance and paired seeds.
measurement.learning_curves: Development-only curves; do not change frozen selection rules or treat tail diagnostics as mathematical optimization convergence.

evidence.availability: External local/managed storage; raw data, checkpoints and pool credentials are not published here.
evidence.absence_policy: Registry validation does not assert that external evidence exists or that the running experiment has completed.

archive_provenance.historical_source: Earlier experiments remain in torchcst history and ignored evidence archives; they were not copied into this repository.
archive_provenance.result_policy: Existing results remain tied to their original source commit, dataset, workload, hardware and job. Registration here is not rerunning, adopting or verifying those results.
